info.title: TaskForge API
info.description: Authentication-enabled API for TaskForge. Use the `/auth/login` or `/auth/register` endpoints to obtain a JWT before calling protected routes.

sessionCookie.name: tf_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by the auth routes. The cookie carries the same JWT used for bearer authentication.

sessionBridgeSecret.name: x-session-bridge-secret
sessionBridgeSecret.description: Shared server-side secret used by the web app to exchange a NextAuth session for API JWTs.

jobSecretHeader.name: x-job-secret
jobSecretHeader.description: Shared secret required by protected background job routes.

jobSecretBearer.description: Alternative protected job authentication using `Authorization: Bearer <DIGEST_JOB_SECRET>`.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT used for API requests.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived JWT used to request new access tokens.

user.description: Authenticated user when available; `null` if unauthenticated.

emailPreference.description: Email preferences for the authenticated user. Present on `/api/taskforge/v1/me`.

get.summary: List tasks for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns a paginated collection of the signed-in user's tasks. Requires a valid JWT via `Authorization` header or the `tf_session` cookie.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter tasks that include the specified tag(s). Repeat the parameter to require multiple tags.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over the title and description.

parameters.name: dueFrom
parameters.description: Only return tasks due on or after this ISO timestamp.

parameters.name: dueTo
parameters.description: Only return tasks due on or before this ISO timestamp.

get.summary: Retrieve the Kanban board read model
get.description: Returns a board-friendly representation of tasks grouped by status lanes. Repeating `tag` requires tasks to include every selected tag. Requires a valid JWT via `Authorization` header or the `tf_session` cookie.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter board tasks by workflow status.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter board tasks that include the specified tag(s). Repeat the parameter to require multiple tags.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over the title and description.

parameters.name: dueFrom
parameters.description: Only return board tasks due on or after this ISO timestamp.

parameters.name: dueTo
parameters.description: Only return board tasks due on or before this ISO timestamp.

ETag.description: Entity tag representing the latest board update timestamp.

dueFrom: dueFrom must be earlier than or equal to dueTo
